items.headline: Micron shares fell 5.5% on Thursday after a broader memory-chip selloff, with Barron’s framing the move as a potential rebound opportunity.
Micron shares rose 19.3% in a Bloomberg Television segment after UBS reportedly boosted its price target to more than $1,600 a share.
Micron was cited in market coverage as facing semiconductor headwinds tied to AI-infrastructure spending concerns.
